CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

July 9, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:05 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER

Absent:
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: June 25, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the June 25, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  801-817 East Main Street and 17-25 North Granada Avenue, DRB-
  2024-00032

  •  Request: This is an application for a new multi-family residential development of
  49 dwelling units provided within (16) 3-story buildings totaling 114,730 SF and a
  543 SF community room, related common open space and amenities, private
  garages, and driveways, onsite guest parking and related landscaping.
  •  Applicant: Rick Puffer, Intracorp Homes
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed
  project is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise elevation callouts/keynotes to accurately identify
  certain building elements throughout the drawing set including, but not limited
  to, window types, door types, and exterior architectural features.
  2. Substantially consistent and minor modifications, alterations, or changes to
  the building exteriors, locations, materials, colors, and/or scale made during
  plan check and/or construction shall be re-submitted to the City Architect to
  review and approve. Major modifications that involve material expansion or
  intensification of development or material modifications to the architectural
  design that differ from what is presented in the July 9th DRB meeting shall be
  re-submitted for review by the Design Review Board to approve, modify, or
  deny.
  3. Any minor modification, alteration, or replacement made during plan check
  and/or construction, of doors, windows, awnings, railings, or any other
  exterior architectural features shall be re-submitted to the City Architect to
  review and approve if consistent with applicable, objective design and
  development standards. If the City Architect determines that the proposed
  changes are major modifications or inconsistent with applicable, objective
  design and development standards, the proposed changes shall be re-
  submitted for review by the Design Review Board to approve, modify, or
  deny, at the discretion of the City Architect.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the item with the following
  conditions:
  1. The applicant shall revise elevation callouts/keynotes to accurately identify
  certain building elements throughout the drawing set including, but not limited
  to, window types, door types, and exterior architectural features.
  2. To be substantially consistent and any minor modifications, alterations, or
  changes, as suggested to the architectural firm, to the building exteriors,
  locations, materials, colors, and/or scale made during plan check and/or
  construction shall be re-submitted to the City Architect to review and approve.
  Any major modifications that involve material expansion or intensification of
  development or material modifications to the architectural design that differ
  from what is presented in the July 9th DRB meeting shall be re-submitted for
  review by the Design Review Board to approve, modify, or deny.
  3. Any minor modification, alteration, or replacement made during plan check
  and/or construction, of doors, windows, awnings, railings, or any other

  2
   exterior architectural features shall be re-submitted to the City Architect to
  review and approve if consistent with applicable, objective design and
  development standards. If the City Architect determines that the proposed
  changes are major modifications or inconsistent with applicable, objective
  design and development standards, the proposed changes shall be re-
  submitted for review by the Design Review Board to approve, modify, or
  deny, at the discretion of the City Architect.

  •  The second was by Board member Daninger
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 9:30 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on July 23, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 9:30 P.M.
  •  The second was by Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
